incompatibility_reasons: Feature namespace mismatch: ADFA-LD uses 'sc_<id>_count' (integer IDs), PLAID uses 'sc_<name>_count' (strings).
Kernel ABI differences: ADFA-LD was recorded on Linux 2.6.38 (32-bit x86), PLAID was recorded on Linux 4.15+ (64-bit x86_64).
Syscall table divergence: Syscall numbers in 32-bit and 64-bit Linux do not map 1:1, and original ADFA-LD mapping table was lost.
Dimensionality mismatch: ADFA-LD has 442 features vs PLAID's 401 features.
conclusion: Cross-dataset direct transfer confirms domain shift: structural features alone cannot generalize across different host environments (e.g. desktop Ubuntu 11.10 vs containerized multi-benchmark server). Chronicle must maintain dedicated dataset-specific models while standardizing the ingestion schema.
